content.short: TractionEye turns trader signals into Telegram-based pools where traders earn from profits and followers join deals.
content.description: TractionEye is a trading-signal and pool platform, not a block explorer. Traders can share deals from Telegram and earn a share of pool profits, while followers join trader-led opportunities with equal conditions and less manual copy-trading friction. Or join the pool and profit from the trader's wins!.
